data.one_liner: A Dart library that parses and renders Mustache templates.
data.what_it_does: It parses Mustache template strings into Template objects and can render them with provided data maps. Supports strict and lenient modes, partials, lambdas, and HTML escaping control.
use_when: You need server‑side or client‑side text generation using the Mustache syntax.
You want a pure‑Dart solution without external dependencies.
avoid_when: You require a full UI widget library or state‑management solution.
You need a template engine with built‑in HTML sanitization beyond simple escaping.
strengths: Zero external dependencies and pure Dart implementation.
Supports Mustache spec, partials, lambdas, and both strict and lenient modes.
weaknesses: Only handles text templating; no integration with UI frameworks.
Limited to Mustache features; no advanced templating extensions.
